title: Budgets, Discounts and Money
introduction: Build Primary 4 mathematical understanding through budgets, discounts and money.
definition: A budget sets a spending limit. A discount reduces an original price. Calculate the discount from the original price and subtract it to obtain the sale price. Work in matching currency units.

examples.question: An RM80 item is discounted by 15%. Find its sale price.
A budget of RM120 covers three items costing RM35.50, RM28.90 and RM19.60.

exercises.question: 10% discount on RM90. Sale price in RM?
exercises.solution: Discount = RM90 × 10/100 = RM9. Sale price = RM90 − RM9 = RM81.

exercises.question: 25% discount on RM120. Discount in RM?
Budget RM200, spend RM146.75. Remaining RM?
RM100 paid for RM67.85. Change RM?
20% discount on RM75. Sale price RM?
exercises.solution: Discount = RM75 × 20/100 = RM15. Sale price = RM75 − RM15 = RM60.

summary: A budget sets a spending limit. A discount reduces an original price. Calculate the discount from the original price and subtract it to obtain the sale price. Work in matching currency units.
